args.decision: Which new local resource investigation should precede another menu capture for original livery fidelity?

args.evidence: All136 livery PTG files are byte-bound and independently decoded. Their actual game consumer remains unproven. Fresh menu builder passes GRAPHICS\\GAME\\LIVERY\\%s.PSD to FUN0015b280 but C pseudocode does not read first parameter. Shipped livery directory contains Thumbs.db 195584 bytes, not yet parsed. It may include JPEG reference images and catalog names, which could corroborate composition but cannot prove game loading. A paused race97 joins six cars with144 nonzero mutable rotations; rotation host model remains separate from original draw proof.
args.priorities: User requests deeply inspect refreshed game resources, creatively use Jev, recover original assets fully. Keep source read-only and avoid desktop focus. Prefer novel measurable evidence with bounded parsing and no game memory writes.
requirements: Provides a new, independent resource relevant to livery image composition.
